sq: Pranë Prishtinës së sotme lulëzoi qyteti romak i Ulpianës.
Nën perandorin Trajan (98–117), ai mori statusin e municipiumit dhe emrin e familjes së tij, Ulpius.
en: Near today's Prishtina, the Roman city of Ulpiana flourished.
Under Emperor Trajan (98–117) it became a municipium and took the name of his family, the Ulpii.
Archaeologists are still excavating it today.

imageAlt.sq: Pamje nga ajri e parkut arkeologjik të Ulpianës.
imageAlt.en: Aerial view of the Ulpiana archaeological park.
